title: stoa-verify dkim.rs: DkimResult error reasons use Debug format — leaks Rust internals to operator DB
description: In dkim.rs, DkimResult::Neutral/Fail/PermError/TempError all format the error with {:?} (Debug). This embeds Rust enum discriminant text into the article_verifications.reason column visible to operators. Use Display format or to_string() instead of format!("{err:?}").
